notes.title: Announcing updates and the successor game『BOKURA: planet』
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This is tokoronyori.
Thank you for playing BOKURA.

On August 10th, 『BOKURA』will be celebrating its first anniversary.
I am adding support for the following languages and holding a first anniversary sale with 50%off!

- Danish
- Swedish
- Czech
- Portuguese (Portugal)
- Dutch

And today, I am very happy to announce 『BOKURA: planet』 a successor to BOKURA!!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126150]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126150[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457849/091d8a7dc632e687c049faae7a6a8a6d548c03e4.png[/img]

Like BOKURA, in this game 2 players try to communicate and cooperate with the other player on what they see to try solve puzzles in each stage.
But there is one crucial difference in this game, which lets you experience a new possibility in 2 player only co-op games.

In this game the action「push」has been added.
You can push your partner away, or even off a cliff.
Not only can you enjoy the cooperation with your partner, you can enjoy the grudge & intensity not seen much in other co-op games.

A little story time.
『BOKURA: planet』is based on an idea I had when planning for BOKURA.
At that time, I could have extended that idea away from BOKURA but due to balance and many other things, BOKURA happened.
I still believe in that decision, but I kept on thinking "How different it would have been and what would I be seeing."
That feeling caught up to me at last and created 『BOKURA: planet』
The view that I see now from this game is so different from what I expected, and I really want to share this view with you as soon as possible.

The game is now under development and I aim to release it at the beginning of 2025.
Please wishlist the game and await for the update!

I hope you continue to enjoy 『BOKURA』
And of course, I hope you look forward to 『BOKURA: planet』

notes.title: Update（ver.0.9.0）Announcing game updates & price change due to the game going fu
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is tokoronyori.
I want to thank everybody for playing Bokura!

For this announcement, I wanted to let everyone know a pre-emptive update towards the full release,
and some changes we are making to the game and the price change.

【Updates】
ver0.9.0
・Additional ending
・A new stage added along the additional ending
・An overhaul of the final stage
・A new gimmick added along the overhaul
・Some bug fixes

This is planned to be the last big update that will include additional content or overhauls.
I hope that everyone will enjoy the Bokura that we built, through the feedbacks and comments from the community.

【The removal of the Friend's Pass and changes to the pricing】
First, to the point. 
The changes being made, with the full release on August 10th, are as follows, 
・The Friend's Pass discontinuation as of August 10th
・The change in pricing as of August 10th (Around half the current price)

I want to be as transparent as possible, so I will explain as much as I can.
Along with the full release on August 10th, the game will have "crossplay" and the game will be playable between Steam, Nintendo Switch and iOS/Android
As the game is co-op "exclusive", the huge wall of 「being on the same platform as your partner」 was something I really wanted to take away.

The development process was not straight forward, but with the help from the Switch porting team, we were able to create an environment where each player can play comfortably on their own platform.

On the other end, to realize the Friend's Pass playability for multiple platforms was much more difficult than expected.
We thought that, servicing each platform, providing a constant and stable gameplay experience, and updating multiple platforms all at once would overwhelm us, as we are a small team.

After many discussions with our publisher, we came to the very difficult decision of removing the Friend's Pass.
After August 10th, new downloads of the Friend's Pass will not be possible.
I personally believe the Friend's Pass system is amazing, and I really wanted it to live. It pains me this is our conclusion, and I want to apologize for the result.

Steam Friend's Pass players will be able to play the additional content of this new update until the August 10th full release update. 
After August 10th the game will be unplayable for the Friend's Pass.
Although it will be for a short period of time, we hope you can enjoy the additional contents until the full release.

In conjunction with the removal of the Friend's Pass, the price of the game will be halved from the current price on August 10th to make it even for each player. (This will be done for each region)
The change in pricing will occur not only on Steam, but for Nintendo Switch and iOS/Android.

The new pricing will be implemented at the same time as the full release on August 10th,
If anyone is thinking of purchasing the Steam version of the game, we recommend waiting until the new pricing is in place.

I want to thank everyone again, and I hope you will enjoy 『Bokura』

notes.title: Announcing "Joining Steam Summer Sale" & "Adding a new ending!"
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
This is tokoronyori.

Thank very much for playing『Bokura』
I have 2 new announcements to make!




[h3][b]【30%OFF at Steam Summer Sale】[/b][/h3]
『Bokura』is participating in the Steam Summer Sale which began today.
The game is availavble at a 30% discount, so now is the chance to upgrade the game from wishlist to purchase!




[h3][b]【Adding a new ending!】
[/b][/h3]Around early August, before te full release of the Steam version on August 10th, the game will receive a free update to add an ending!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457849/e64ff3418f721143a27fb21bf96321a12d8a51ce.png[/img]
You will be able to enjoy a new story after the current ending.
With new stages also added, you can see a glimpse of what may happen after what "bokura" experienced on that day in winter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457849/6541b8300677a90585a94e6aed6d671e00f3fc56.png[/img]


The game was released as early access on Febuary 14th, 2023, and has now over 70,000 downloads thanks to everyone.
I never expected to receive so many amazing reactions and comments from around the world!
I really feel and appreciate that the memories of this game has found a spot in your hearts.

I have read many comments pondering on what happens beyond the ending.
Through your words, the desire for me to create a place that only the players who love the game can reach, erupted in my heart.

This was something not planned in the initial plot but I think this is something that everyone, including players that finished the game, can enjoy.
It is coming very soon, so I hope you will look forward to the update as much as I am.




Thank you again and see you soon.

notes.title: Update（ver0.3.0）
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
This is tokoronyori.

I hope you are enjoying『Bokura』

There were reports in the disscussions and reviews of matching issues and lag.
I have been planning and working on a fundamental revision of the network system used in the game in order to solve the problem, and this update should fix these issues.

I hope this leads to a more comfortable playing environment for everyone.

－－－－－

ver 0.3.0 
〇System update
　・Stabilized network environment 
　・Added region selection 
　・Addressed the problem that prevented matching under certain environments. 

〇In-game changes/adjustments
　・A mute icon will be shown when the players begin separate activities 


★Regarding region selection 
　The default setting 'AUTO' automatically selects the most suitable region. 
　If you want to be matched with a player who is far away from you (e.g. from a different country) or if you cannot be matched using AUTO, select a specific region together.
　If two people select different regions, they cannot be matched.


★Region list 
　・AUTO - Auto connects to the most suitable region 
　・ASIA - Asia
　・EU - Europe 
　・JP - Japan 
　・KR - Korea 
　・SA - South America 
　・US - United States

－－－－－

Due to how the game is built, the game has to be played between the same version.
If two different versions are connected, the host (purchased version) will receive the error message
“App version mismatch. Update to latest version”

If this appears, please enable Steam auto-update and restart Steam before playing the game.


Thank you again for your continued support for Bokura!

Added region selection

tags.bug: Addressed the problem that prevented matching under certain environments.
